title: Mere Khutbou Sai Toot Jaye Ga Tere Darbar ka Ghuroor Sabhi
body:
Bandh Haatou Sai Main Mita Dungi Tujh Gunahgar Ka Ghuroor Sabhi
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu Nai Lashay Bichaye Karbal Main, Phir Ridaou Ko Sar Sai Loot Liya,
Tukre Tukre Karounge Shaam Tere, Takhte Aghyar Ka Ghuroor Sabhi
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaari Quran Nok E Naiza Pai, Yai Bataya Hussain Zinda Hai,
Huwe Barbaad Tere Sab Lashkar, Teri Lalkar Ka Ghuroor Sabhi
<<DIVIDER>>
Naam E Zainab Zuban Pai Tu Laya, Bharay Darbariou Ki Mehfil Main,
Thar Tharaye Ga Mere Haibat Sai, Tere Guftaar Ka Ghuroor Sabhi
<<DIVIDER>>
Qatl Karne Ko Agaya Tu Bhi, Mere Sajjad Ko Mere Houte,
Akh Kardoungi Ek Lamhay Main, Tere Talwar Ka Ghuroor Sabhi
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghairatou Kai Baha Diye Dariya, Har Ansou Main Laash Thi Uski,
Zakhmi Qadmou Sai Rond Aya Hai, Sajay Bazaar Ka Ghuroor Sabhi
<<DIVIDER>>
Tune Jakra Jisse Zanjeerou Sai, Yehi Sajjad Misl E Haider Hai,
Yai Tou Ghash Main Bhi Tor Sakta Hai, Tujh Khatakar Ka Ghuroor Sabhi
<<DIVIDER>>
Safar Mera Bharray Bazarou Main, Khoon Sajjad Ko Rulata Hai,
Houga Pamaal Tere Wehshat Sai, Dar O Dewar Ka Ghuroor Sabhi
<<DIVIDER>>
Tasht Main Hai Sar E Hussain Parra, Mere Daman Main Urh Kai Ajaye,
Rab E Adil Yai Mojiza Dekho, Tarpai Maikhar Ka Ghuroor Sabhi
